details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:78-524 (ISSUE_START_RE cited at line 78 / 96 / 105; `consolidator_ran = True` branch at lines 521-524; `_issue_id_pattern` at line 374) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_START_RE = re.compile(r"^=== ISSUE ([0-9]+) ===$")` does not match the `=== ISSUE PASSTHROUGH ${pass_code} ===` blocks that scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh writes at lines 954 and 962 and joins into REVIEW_ISSUES_FILE at line 969, so the record skips them with no warning while `consolidator_ran` is still set true for any non-empty issues file.
  WHY: The record shows `outcome=written`, no warnings and too few issues (or `issue_count=0` when the file holds only passthrough blocks), which disagrees with what the editor processed; sonnet adds that passthrough codes 001, 002 and so on can match `_issue_id_pattern("001")` and set the disposition of consolidated issue 001. Severity disagreement: minimax said MAJOR, while sonnet, gemini and glm said NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:254-267 (`_flagged_by_token`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The prefix-strip loop is said to strip `review_` from the parser's `reviewer_N` tokens, so `reviewer_3` becomes `er_3`, and test_production_token_shapes_are_kept at tests/test_review_chatgpt_findings_record.py:441-461 cannot pass.
  WHY: Findings would be credited to a reviewer that does not exist (`er_3`) in review_findings_record.json. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and called it false: `"reviewer_3".startswith("review_")` is False because the 7th character is `e`, not `_`.
- agents.d/chatgpt-review-findings-record.md:2 (vs scripts/review_findings_record.py:267 `return safe_to_slug.get(name, name)`) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says FLAGGED_BY tokens that match no panel slot are recorded "as written", but the code records them with the `review_` / `pass1_` prefix already stripped (for example `review_foo_bar` becomes `foo_bar` and `pass1_foo` becomes `foo`).
  WHY: Phase 4 tooling or operators that follow the documented contract and look for `review_<safe>` / `pass1_<safe>` tokens will not find them; either the code (`safe_to_slug.get(name, entry)`) or the fragment must change.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:535-537 (`if runtime_dir:` guard around the PARSER_STATS_FILE read) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An explicit PARSER_STATS_FILE override is honoured only when RUNTIME_DIR is set, while the REVIEW_ISSUES_FILE and EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE overrides are honoured without it.
  WHY: A caller that overrides the parser-stats path without exporting RUNTIME_DIR silently loses the `consolidator_parse_failed` warning. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The record must be a no-op, or carry only the plan's 'disabled' state, while reviewer_slot_enabled in .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json is false. Do not change that value."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_findings_record.py — build_record() / run_write()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: When the slot is disabled, build_record() sets `chatgpt_slot` to `{"enabled": false, "slug": null, "status": null}` at lines 504-511, then still calls collect_slot_statuses, parse_review_issues and parse_editor_summary at lines 504-556, and run_write() writes the full record (slots, consolidator, issues, editor, warnings) at lines 587-588. No disabled-state path makes the record a no-op. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this gap, citing docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md line 264, which says Phase 3 "Works with or without Phase 2".
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:78, 521-523, 374 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_START_RE = re.compile(r"^=== ISSUE ([0-9]+) ===$")` skips the `=== ISSUE PASSTHROUGH ${pass_code} ===` blocks written by scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh (lines 954, 962) and joined into REVIEW_ISSUES_FILE (line 969), so `consolidator.issue_count` and `issues[]` leave them out with no warning. `_issue_id_pattern("001")` can also match "PASSTHROUGH 001" in editor bullets.
  WHY: With `parse_failed=0`, the record reports `outcome=written warnings=none` with fewer issues than the editor processed. Suggested fix: count `^=== ISSUE PASSTHROUGH [0-9]+ ===$` lines and add a `passthrough_blocks_skipped` warning.
- agents.d/chatgpt-review-findings-record.md:2 vs scripts/review_findings_record.py:267 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fragment says "other valid tokens as written", but `return safe_to_slug.get(name, name)` returns the token with its prefix stripped (`review_foo_bar` becomes `foo_bar`).
  WHY: Phase 4 tooling that looks for `review_<safe>` tokens will not find them; fix with `safe_to_slug.get(name, entry)` or reword the fragment.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_findings_record.py build_record lines 535-537 — an explicit PARSER_STATS_FILE is ignored when RUNTIME_DIR is unset; fix with `stats_path = _env("PARSER_STATS_FILE") or (...)`, 3 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTES (4 related items): no trust-boundary risk, because review_findings_record.py is not staged and runs from `.codex-workflow-src` (review_autofix.yml line 4054); the disabled-state TASK_GAP is rejected per plan line 264; the `reviewer_3` → `er_3` claim is false; the fsync finding is already fixed; tabs-to-spaces is rejected; the static-checks and Copilot check failures are curl 504 infrastructure errors.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:_flagged_by_token function | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The prefix-strip logic strips `review_` from `reviewer_N` tokens because they start with the `review_` prefix in REVIEWER_TOKEN_PREFIXES.
  WHY: `reviewer_N` tokens are mangled into `er_N`, which breaks attribution of findings in the ChatGPT reviewer trial.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:parse_review_issues function | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: ISSUE_START_RE matches only `=== ISSUE <n> ===` and not `=== ISSUE PASSTHROUGH <n> ===` blocks.
  WHY: Passthrough blocks are silently skipped and findings are under-counted with no warning, even though the consolidator ran.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: The record must be a no-op, or carry only the plan's 'disabled' state, while reviewer_slot_enabled in .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json is false.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_findings_record.py, build_record()
  Evidence of absence: When the slot is disabled, build_record() sets 'enabled' to false but still collects slot statuses, consolidator findings, the issue list and editor summaries, and writes them all.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING: scripts/review_findings_record.py write_atomic() — the parent directory is not fsync'd after os.replace(); fix with os.open(parent, os.O_RDONLY) plus os.fsync(dir_fd), 4 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The `review_` prefix strip turns the parser's `reviewer_3` (KNOWN_REVIEWERS regex at scripts/review_parse_consolidator.sh:394) into `er_3`, so test_production_token_shapes_are_kept at tests/test_review_chatgpt_findings_record.py:441-461 cannot pass.

  WHY: The editor's per-issue dispositions silently disagree with the record whenever passthrough blocks are emitted.
- scripts/review_findings_record.py:536 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The PARSER_STATS_FILE override is honoured only when RUNTIME_DIR is set, unlike REVIEW_ISSUES_FILE and EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE.
  WHY: Overriding the stats path without RUNTIME_DIR drops `parse_failed` warnings.

  WHY: A Phase 4 consumer that matches `review_<safe_name>` will not find the tokens.

  Evidence of absence: With chatgpt_slug = None, the disabled shape is set at lines 507-508, but collect_slot_statuses, parse_review_issues and parse_editor_summary still run at lines 504-555, and run_write() writes the full record at lines 587-588.
